title: ZAINAB KI TAMANNA HAI CHELUM HU BAHATTAR KA
body:
ZAINAB KI TAMANNA HAI CHELUM HU BAHATTAR KA
HAR SAANS KARE MATAM HAR AANKH KARE GIRYA
1.Kal Zainab e Muztar Par Tufaan They Mazalim Ke
Baazu Pa Badhi Rassi Majboor Thi Matam Se
Us Gham Zada Bibi Ku Dena Hai Hume Pursa
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Jab Choth Ke Haram Aaye Zindan Aaziyath Se
Dil Bibiou Ke Tadpe Karbal Ki Ziyarath Se
Khabre Jo Nazar Aayi Ek Hashr Howa Barpa
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Shabbir Ki Turbat Par Zainab Ne Kahan Rokar
Main Aayi Hu Aaye Bhai Har Ranj o Alam Sehkar
Jee Bhar Ke Kabhi Tumku Main Ro Na saki Bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Tadhpati Reh Reh Kar Bazarou Ki Zebayi
Bhai Teri Zainab Par Haste They Tamashai
Sar Sharm Se Balwe Me Uthaa Na Kabhi Mera
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Baazu Pa Naasha Lekar Kaise Main Watan Jaoun
Jo Zulm Howe Hum Par Kis Tarah Se Batlaou
Sughra Se Milo Kaise Kya Usse Kahu Bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Akber Ka Kiya Matam Qasim Ku Kabhi Royi
Abbas Ki Turbat Par Yeh Kehte Howe Doudhi
Kis Kis Ka Karu Chelum Koi Na Raha Mera
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Hai Saya Figan Bibi Zainab Ki Dua Hum Par
Moula Ki Zamanath Me Sab Matami Aye Manzar
Badhta Hi Rahe Har Yeh Karwa Aza Ka
